description: G.D. Janani Perera v. University of Moratuwa and Others G.D. Janani Perera v. University of Moratuwa and Others View More before Hon. S. Srikandarajah, J.
parties: G.D. Janani Perera v. University of Moratuwa and Others G.D. Janani Perera v. University of Moratuwa and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the order of the Governing Council of the 1st Respondent demoting her position and the order of the University Services Appeals Board dismissing the appeal; considered grant of leave for study and employment abroad as interchangeable. Held - 1st Respondent is the disciplinary authority in terms of the University Act No. 16 of 1978; Petitioner was not prejudiced by any reference to the Establishment Code in the charge sheet; Petitioner failed contractual obligations. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
